_about: MCP servers the installer registers with Claude Code (user scope). Keys are asked for at install time and never stored in this repo; a server whose key is skipped is not added. Packages verified on npm 2026-11-20.

servers.name: awwwards
servers.what: Design inspiration from award-winning sites: search with screenshots, pull design DNA, capture live sites. No key.

servers.name: magic-ui
servers.what: Magic UI animated components (shimmer, marquee, beams...). No key.

servers.name: shadcn
servers.what: Browse and install shadcn/ui components. No key.

servers.name: playwright
servers.what: Drive a real browser to check pages. No key.

servers.name: chrome-devtools
servers.what: Performance traces, console, network, Lighthouse-style checks. No key.

servers.name: context7
servers.what: Up-to-date docs for GSAP, Three.js, Next.js, Tailwind... Key optional (higher limits).

servers.name: threejs-devtools
servers.what: Inspect and edit a running Three.js / R3F scene live. No key.

servers.name: lottiefiles-creator
servers.what: Create and edit Lottie animations. No key.

servers.name: figma
servers.what: Figma's official Dev Mode server (hosted). Sign in with /mcp in Claude Code after install.

servers.name: firecrawl
servers.what: Scrape and crawl reference sites into clean markdown.

servers.name: vercel
servers.what: Vercel's hosted server: deployments, logs, projects. Sign in with /mcp after install.

account_connectors: Higgsfield, Netlify, 21st.dev (connector), Gmail, Google Drive and other claude.ai connectors follow your Claude account; connect them in claude.ai Settings > Connectors on any computer.
